title: NuScale Power Implements Everstar’s Gordian AI Platform to Accelerate Commercial Reactor Deployment
summary: NuScale Power announced the deployment of Gordian, Everstar’s nuclear-specific artificial intelligence (AI) platform.
body_markdown:
CORVALLIS, Ore. and NEW YORK — NuScale Power Corporation (NYSE: SMR), the industry-leading provider of proprietary and innovative advanced small modular reactor (SMR) nuclear technology, today announced the deployment of Gordian, Everstar’s nuclear-specific artificial intelligence (AI) platform, across functions supporting the commercial deployment of NuScale’s U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission-approved SMR technology.


Everstar brings together capabilities in nuclear policy, AI research, product development, and engineering to build tools for the nuclear industry. Among other capabilities, Gordian applies nuclear regulatory frameworks across connected document sets to assist users in assessing the potential effects of engineering revisions. It also combines workflows for repeatable tasks with a natural-language interface guided by nuclear-specific instructions.


Following a successful initial pilot period that yielded efficiency gains, NuScale is now expanding Gordian’s use within its licensing, plant services, project management, supply chain, quality assurance, and product development areas. The platform helps NuScale teams shorten timelines and reduce the burden of document-intensive work, enabling them to apply their deep technical expertise across a greater scope of projects than was previously possible. Gordian’s implementation supports NuScale’s efforts to accelerate the safe and efficient commercial deployment of its NuScale Power Modules™ (NPMs).


“Gordian amplifies the experience and talent of the NuScale team, helping us apply our technical knowledge over a broader range of work,” said Dr. José Reyes, Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer of NuScale Power. “The Gordian platform takes on time-consuming tasks, allowing NuScale to focus on the engineering and decisions that move projects forward, ultimately compressing timelines and reducing costs while maintaining the rigor needed in the nuclear industry.”


NuScale and Everstar are actively evaluating a broader set of applications to realize additional efficiency gains. “The nuclear industry is entering a new era of innovation, efficiency, and predictability,” said Kevin Kong, Chief Executive Officer of Everstar. “NuScale is leading the way by setting a new standard for project execution, cost certainty, and schedule reliability, and we are proud to support their efforts.”


## **About NuScale Power**


Founded in 2007, NuScale Power Corporation (NYSE: SMR) is the industry-leading provider of proprietary and innovative advanced small modular reactor (SMR) nuclear technology, with a mission to help power the global energy transition by delivering safe, scalable, and reliable carbon-free energy. The NuScale Power Module™, the Company’s groundbreaking SMR technology, is a small, safe, pressurized water reactor that can each generate 77 megawatts of electricity (MWe) or 250 megawatts thermal (gross), and can be scaled to meet customer needs through an array of flexible configurations up to 924 MWe (12 modules) of output.


As the first and only SMR to have its designs certified by the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission, NuScale is well-positioned to serve diverse customers across the world by supplying nuclear energy for electrical generation, data centers, district heating, desalination, commercial-scale hydrogen production, and other process heat applications.


## **About Everstar**


Everstar’s mission is to engineer the abundant power source for humanity’s next epoch. Headquartered in New York, the company builds the intelligence and manufacturing capacity to cut the cost of U.S. nuclear reactor deployments by an order of magnitude.


Its nuclear-forward AI platform, Gordian, is grounded in regulatory frameworks and plant engineering data. Operating utilities, reactor developers, national laboratories, manufacturers, and regulators in the U.S. and abroad use it to compress months of licensing, engineering, and operations work into days. Everstar is now deploying Physical AI, robotics, and streamlined qualification to accelerate fabricating and deploying nuclear reactors at the speed of national need.
